_about: English screen strings (design/ui2/SPEC.md, language system). Same keys as hi.json; app/tests/test_i18n.py checks parity. {x} slots are filled by the page; payload values keep their data-f marker.
app.name: Bharosa
lang.name: English
lang.later: You can change this later in Settings.
nav.label: Main
sos.label: Emergency numbers
sos.102_sub: Pregnant woman or baby. Free. No answer? Call 108
danger.3: Labour with bleeding, or baby stuck
danger.5: Burn on face or a large area
home.danger_note: Checklist written by the team, not checked by a doctor.
home.where_first: First tell us where the patient is.
gps.wait: Stand outside. This can take up to 2 minutes.
gps.none: This phone has no GPS in the browser. Choose a place instead.
gps.blocked: GPS is blocked for this site. Type a PIN, district, town or post office instead.
gps.failed: Could not get GPS. Stand outside, or choose a place instead.
place.label: PIN, district, town or post office, or 'lat, lon'
place.help: With internet: any PIN, district, town or post office name in India. Add the state if many places share the name, for example Rampur, Bihar. Without internet: a PIN or district of a state saved on this phone. Coordinates always work, for example 26.59, 85.48.
place.pin_missing: PIN {v} is not in our PIN list. Check the number, or type the district or town name.
offline.not_yet: Saved for use without internet: not yet. It saves after your first online answer.
call.number_note: Number from its listing; not checked by us.
ans.no_phone: No phone number in our data for this listing.
ans.listen_na: Read aloud is not available now.
ans.as_of: Listings from the provided dataset; checked and built {date}.
ans.not_advice: This is not a doctor's advice.
ans.stub: Sample data from a stub, not a real recommendation.
ans.abstain_found: No confident option. Showing places to call.
sure.no_text: Its listing does not name this care.
window.label: Time window
window.miss: The best-evidenced option is about {min} min away; that misses the {win}-min window for this care, counted from when the patient leaves.
window.no_public: No hospital in our data nearby is one the public standard expects to offer this care.
far.line: The nearest verified {label} is {km} km away (option {rank}).
far.one: Option {ranks} is closer but not verified: call first.
far.many: Options {ranks} are closer but not verified: call first.
route.intro: {name}: where to go, in order. Times are rough estimates.
route.arrive: Arrive about {low}-{high} min from the start.
route.no_phone: No phone number in our data.
route.ev_more: The strongest are quoted; the rest are in the listing.
route.ev_not_here: The sentences are not in the data on this server.
route.ev_none: No listing sentence in our data for this stop.
route.fallback: If turned away: {name}, arriving about {eta} min from the start (score {p}).
route.totals: Definitive care in about {min} min ({low}-{high}). Score if the listings are right: first care in time {first}, treated {treated}.
route.totals_assume: This assumes each listing is right about what the stop offers, and that one stop saying no tells nothing about the next.
route.check: {check} within {limit} min: {met} (about {eta} min), counted from when the patient leaves.
route.check_short: {check} within {limit} min: {met}, about {eta} min, counted from when the patient leaves.
quote.caption: Lines from the listing, none about {label} on its own
track.none: Listings like this: not checked yet
track.few: Listings like this: too few checks yet ({n} checked)
track.tenths: A web check confirmed about {k} in 10 listings like this ({n} checked with a clear answer; checks that found nothing were not counted)
track.full: Of {n} listings like this ({basis}), a web check confirmed {k}, contradicted {c}, found nothing for {u}
test.line: Likely: {k} of {n} confirmed ({pct}%, interval {lo} to {hi}%) on a test set sealed before the model was frozen; agent-labelled, not human-checked. Not shown to rank public facilities ({pub} public test pairs with a verdict).
tie.caption: Order among tied options
tie.few: fewer than {n} health workers, not counted
tie.rule: After field reports these are in the same band, with chances within {p} and travel within {m} min, so reports set their order: accepted, plus phone yes at half weight, minus 'does not offer'; recent reports count more.
whynot.nearest: The first choice is already the nearest listing that offers {label}.
whynot.below_farther: The places below are farther away.
whynot.confirm_nearer: If {name} confirms on the phone that it offers {label}, it becomes the first choice ({d}).
whynot.first_says_no: If {first} cannot take the patient, call {name} next ({d}).
whynot.about_data: This describes our data, not the facility.
why.no_quote: Our data has no own sentence about {label} for this listing.
why.call_108_first: Call 108 first. Do not wait for this call to send the patient.
why.no_dial: No dialable number in our data for this listing.
why.out_note: Yes, no or no answer is sent to improve the data: this facility, the service, the district and the time. No patient details.
why.noted: Noted: {said}. It goes on the referral slip.
why.noted_sent: Noted: {said}. It goes on the referral slip and is sent to improve the data, with no patient details.
why.noted_no: Noted: said no. Choose a reason or skip.
why.very_unsure: We are very unsure about this one.
why.web_note: Reads its own website now (a few pages, a few seconds). It does not change the answer.
script.if_not: "If you cannot, which hospital nearby can?"
script.whom: "Whom should we ask for when we arrive?"
verify.only: It mentions it only like this:
cmp.here_q: Is the patient here, at this location?
cmp.choose: Choose one to see the comparison.
cmp.elsewhere: Patient is elsewhere: distances are from this location.
cmp.caption: {label}: options side by side
cmp.no_sentence: no sentence about it in the listing
area.pick_first: Choose a service on Home first to see the standing referral plan for this area.
area.pulse_link: What health workers reported in a district
area.unavailable: The area plan is not available ({code}).
area.without: {k} of {n} PIN areas: no option with public evidence within {w} min.
area.access_caption: Access to {label}, share of the sampled PIN areas, counting listings in any district within {w} min
area.row_now: Access now: a Likely listing in reach
area.all_care: Care gap across the sampled district: none of the {n} PIN areas has a confirmed option within {w} min.
area.claiming: {n} listings in {district} say they offer {label}; {k} of them rated Likely.
area.other_districts: The PIN areas below also count listings in other districts.
area.covered: Covered: {n} PIN areas have a Likely option within {w} min.
area.not_confirmed: Care gap, not confirmed: {n} PIN areas have listings within {w} min that say they offer it, none rated Likely. A phone call can settle it.
area.far: Care gap, too far: {n} PIN areas: every listing that claims it is more than {w} min away.
area.no_claim: Data gap: {n} PIN areas: no listing in our data within {r} km claims it. We cannot tell whether care exists there.
area.sample: PIN sample: the first {n} of {of} PIN areas in the district, by PIN number.
area.until: Until then, emergencies here go by ambulance: 108 (free).
area.until_102: Until then, emergencies here go by ambulance: 108 (free), or 102 for pregnant women and babies.
area.public_none: The public standard expects a public hospital for this care in every district. Our data lists none in {district}: {n} listing(s) in the district in all, so check the district's own hospital list before planning.
area.public_nearest: Nearest public hospital in our data: {name} ({label}), {km} km.
area.public_far: No public hospital in our data within {r} km.
area.public_list: Hospitals in {district} the public standard expects to offer it:
area.pin_none: No option with public evidence within {w} min;
area.none_sentence: none with its own sentence in our data
area.calls_h: Calls that close the most of the gap
area.calls_caption: Ten calls, most gain first. A yes on the phone is shown, the score does not change.
area.no_calls: No call would close a gap here: every sampled PIN area either has a Likely listing in reach already or has no listing with its own sentence about this care within the time window.
area.stub: Sample area data from a stub; the model export replaces it.
slip.no_name: No patient name or location goes on the slip.
slip.card: Send the family a travel card
slip.card_note: The travel card is a file that opens on any phone without a login: places, phones and what to bring, no patient details.
slip.card_failed: Could not make the travel card. Use the WhatsApp or SMS slip.
slip.load_failed: Could not load the slip. Check the connection.
recent.none: No referrals on this phone in the last 7 days. A referral is remembered here when you make its slip.
page.failed: Could not load this page. Check the connection.
page.english_only: This page is in English only.
err.plan: The server could not make a plan ({code}).
err.not_found: Search again to see this option
err.not_found_help: Options stay only while this page is open. A reloaded page or a shared link does not carry them.
off.banner: Answers come from the data saved on this phone.
off.next: Emergency? Call 108 now. For the full answer, move to where there is signal and tap Try again.
off.nothing: Nothing is saved on this phone yet.
off.showing: Showing what is saved on this phone.
off.signed_out: Signed out. Reload the page to sign in again. Showing saved data meanwhile.
off.server_down: The server is not answering. Showing saved data.
off.slow: The server took more than 8 seconds. Showing saved data.
off.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Showing saved data.
off.built: Facility data built {built}. Saved to this phone {saved} ({age}).
off.no_pack: No saved facility data on this phone yet. It saves after one online answer. Call 108 in an emergency.
off.provisional: Labels are provisional: the model has not published its scores yet.
off.none_near: No facility in the saved data lists {label} near here.
off.pin_line: {loc}. Plan made for the PIN {pin} centre ({district}), {km} km from you.
off.needs_net: Needs internet: note scan, map, road times, places outside {states}.
off.straight: {km} km in a straight line (road is longer).
off.listed: Listed {n} times in the data; shown once, with the best evidenced listing's score.
off.directory: May be a directory number, not the hospital.
off.sms: {label}: {name}. {km} km straight line. {phone}Call before going. Emergency 108.

input.none_found: No service found. Pick a tile.
input.keyboard_mic: Use your keyboard's mic to speak.
input.note_offline: Reading a note needs the internet. Use the search box or a tile.

input.note_photo: Take a photo of the note

why.no_text_other: {band}: no line in its listing describes {label} as its own service, so it is not rated Likely. It is still plausible: the model scores it {p} from the rest of its record (How we decided, below).

place.too_coarse: Your phone's location is too rough to use. Type a PIN, district or town.
place.coords_outside: These coordinates are outside India. Type a PIN, district or town in India.
why.cite.precision: In a hand check our matches to this list were right {k} of {n} times.
